spawn.desc: launch an interactive agent in <project>; /spawn <project> --resume-session <uuid> [--hashtag <h>] resumes a session (e.g. a hand-opened one) in a screen, listener re-armed

kill.desc: kill an agent: /kill <hashtag> (tele-* screen) or /kill pid:<PID> [--restart] (any claude process of yours, owner only, SIGTERM; --restart resumes its session in a screen)

ls.desc: list running agents in two sections — 📺 screens, then 🖥 terminal claude processes — with pid, cwd, full session id, #hashtag

whisper.desc: discreet steer into a topic: /whisper #<hash> <text> (or reply to a previous whisper)

instruct.desc: official private instruction to a topic; agent replies via DM: /instruct #<hash> <text> (or reply to continue)

pending.desc: list convos waiting on an admin reply

broadcast.desc: system message to ALL live topics: /broadcast [--chat <id>] <text>

cswap.desc: Claude account switcher: /cswap = list accounts, /cswap <n> = switch to account n

help.desc: list all commands + their sample syntax

merge.desc: merge GitHub PRs in order: /merge <project> <pr#> [<pr#> …] or /merge <PR URL> [<PR URL> …] [--squash|--merge|--rebase] [--keep-branch] [--force] (default squash; stops at the first failure; via the API, local checkout untouched); add --close to close PRs without merging

restartd.desc: restart the daemon (systemd service); refuses while agents share its cgroup unless KillMode=process or --force

reload.desc: re-read commands.json + projects.json without restarting the daemon
